facts.fact: Mauritius's Central Informatics Bureau lists among its operational systems a 'Chatbot for Government + Mobile App MAIA', run under the Ministry of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation.

facts.fact: The Central Informatics Bureau's list of operational systems names a National Authentication Framework (MauPass) and a Certificate Authority (Mausign) under the Ministry of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation.
The list names three operational authentication services of the state: MauPass, the Mausign certificate authority and the Civil Status Division's Mobile ID with its verifier app.
The list names a Civil Status Division 'Mobile ID - MWA' and a 'Mobile ID Verifier App - MWA Verifier' among operational systems.

systems.owner: Ministry of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation
Ministry of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation

MUS.note: The list names civil status and ID card systems but states no record exchange between them.

systems.system: Companies and Businesses Registration Integrated System - CBRIS

MUS.note: CBRIS is named only; the list does not say what it does, whether registration is online or the number shared.
Only a Consumer Protection Unit MIS is named; nothing on digital financial services rules or complaints.

facts.fact: The Central Informatics Bureau's list of operational systems names the Treasury's Treasury Accounting System (TAS) and the Finance Ministry's E-Budget.
The list names a Payroll System under the Central Information Systems Division among operational systems.

MUS.note: No tax authority system is named.
No enrolment count or share is stated.
No number at birth is described.
The list does not say who operates, maintains or owns the ID system.
No register is said to be keyed on the national ID number.

facts.fact: The Central Informatics Bureau's list names the 'Mauritius National Identity Card System 3.0' run by the Civil Status Division among operational systems.

MUS.note: The list names systems by ministry but states no builder or operator.
